title: Steve's workshop is pitch dark!
_map: Make the bulb light (stretch, usually Y4). Big idea: electricity needs a complete loop (circuit). Creative: wire a battery and bulb in the workshop; find every way to break the circuit.
_story: Steve's workshop is dark. It has a battery, wires and a bulb, but there's a gap. Ismaeel closes the loop, names it a circuit, then hunts for ways to break it.
_stepChain: a battery pushes electricity (solar cube: volts) → it must travel all the way round and back → a gap stops it → a complete loop is called a circuit → close the gap: light → ways to break it: a gap, a loose wire, a flat battery → a switch makes a gap on purpose

talk.ask: Why didn't the bulb light when there was a gap?
talk.goodAnswer: electricity needs a complete loop to flow; the gap broke the loop.

talk.ask: How does a light switch work?
talk.goodAnswer: it makes a gap in the circuit (off) or closes it (on).

handsOn: With a grown-up, find a torch and open it up. Find the battery, the bulb and the switch. Can you see how the switch closes the loop?

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: It's too dark in my workshop! I've got a battery, some wires and a bulb. But the bulb won't light up. Why not?
Electricity flows out of the battery, along the wire, through the bulb, and all the way back to the battery. Look: there's a gap. Electricity can't jump across the gap, so it stops.
Close the gap with a metal spoon. Now electricity can flow all the way round, and the bulb lights up! A complete loop like this is called a circuit.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Now let's break it! I'll take the spoon away again.

question.prompt: What will happen to the bulb?
question.onRight: Yes. A gap breaks the loop, so the electricity stops and the bulb goes off.

0.mistake: thinks the electricity keeps going once started
0.hint: Is the loop still complete without the spoon?
0.say: Without the spoon, there's a gap again. Electricity can't get round, so the bulb goes off straight away.

2.mistake: thinks a gap makes more electricity reach the bulb
2.hint: Can electricity get round the loop with a gap?
2.say: A gap stops the electricity altogether, so the bulb goes dark, not brighter.

narration.text: That's exactly what a light switch does. Switch off: it opens a gap. Switch on: it closes the loop. You've been opening and closing circuits every day!

rule.ask: Can you say why the bulb only lights when the loop is closed? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: Electricity needs a complete loop, called a circuit, to flow. A gap stops it. A switch opens and closes the gap.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: what if the battery is flat, with no push left?
bonus.reveal: It stays dark. The loop is complete, but nothing pushes the electricity round.
